title: Eric H Probable NDE 4588
content: I had been admitted to hospital more than several times suffering complications of the stomach. I had been going in and out of the operating room more than several times and waking up with drips all over me. My mother and maybe it was my aunt, were with me outside the operating room or some corridor of the hospital. I remember I was seated in a wheel chair dressed in hospital garments. All of a sudden, I felt pain. I was rushed back into the operating room and placed on a table. I remember all kinds of hospital instruments been stuck inside me by the doctors, nurses and surgeons working on me immediately. Being a young child, I was physically in pain by the jabbing of sharp hospital instruments. I remember looking at the operating light above me and looking into it. At the moment of time and instant, I could see what seemed like colorful jellyfish-like beings. They were a living form radiating imminent light. Beautiful. There were hundreds, maybe thousands, or even millions. At the same time, I could still see the doctors, nurses and surgeons working on me desperately doing what they had to do. These beautiful colorful radiant jellyfish like beings felt like to me they were waiting for me to take me. They were rainbow colored but could change colors of the light that radiated off them. It's indescribable. I have never seen them in this world. Now all I remember from then is waking up with drips and tubes inside.

arrival.other_being_detail: Colorful, radiant, jellyfish-like beings seen in/near the operating light; described as hundreds/thousands/millions; rainbow-colored and able to change colors; seemed to be waiting to take him.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Repeated hospital admissions and multiple operations for stomach complications; rushed back into operating room after sudden pain.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: While looking into the operating light during surgery, he saw many colorful radiant jellyfish-like beings while simultaneously still seeing medical staff working on him.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience occurred during surgery without reported OBE/tunnel; visual encounter of numerous radiant beings within/around the operating light, then awakening later with tubes.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Simultaneously perceived the operating room staff and the radiant jellyfish-like beings.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Vision of countless rainbow-colored, color-shifting, jellyfish-like luminous beings seen in the operating light while still perceiving the operating room activity.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I could see what seemed like colorful jellyfish-like beings. They were a living form radiating imminent light.”
